claim: The piezo controller gives only limited protection against settings that would damage a connected stage; configuring it is for engineers or technicians with enough expertise to do it safely.
validity_conditions: Read from Nanobench 6000 Customer Interface Software User Manual, PS-000006-UM issue 4 / v1.0.19 (sha256 2acb47b5...): printed page 5 (PDF page 5). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. These manuals are for the controller's software; the archive holds no hardware manual for the stage or the controller. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
